profile.headline: Software Developer at Business Data Inc.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a full customer-facing dashboard, managing end-to-end development: front-end UI/UX, backend logic integration, testing, and optimization.

Built reusable, accessible React components with React 18, CSS, and real-time updates.

Developed and consumed RESTful APIs to maintain consistent, secure data flow across services.

Created SQL queries and integrated BIRT reports for analytics and reporting layers in both React and Java applications.

Collaborated on feature architecture and system design decisions, establishing UI/data flow best practices.

Implemented JWT-based authentication and access control workflows.

Wrote unit tests using JUnit and automated UI tests with Selenium and AIO strategies.

Contributed to CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, reducing manual QA cycles and increasing deployment confidence.

Participated in code reviews, UI performance analysis, and documentation for maintainability.

Led stakeholder meetings to align on product features, timelines, and user feedback. 

Implementation of a ReactJS web application used to download reports, manage and track workflows.

Maintain a Java application that pulls, updates, and adds records to a Microsoft SQL Server Database used to track, update and execute workflows by company operators.

positions.title: Proctor
positions.description:
•	Assist customers with technical troubleshooting issues.
•	Assist with survey process.
•	Conduct recruitment for academic and medical studies.
•	Provide customer service; and, maintain detailed phone logs.

positions.title: IT/Clerical Assistant (Student Assistant)
positions.description:
•	Liaison with department end users assisting with Website programming and updates.
•	Provide Content Management System (CM1) end user training support.
•	Maintain College Facebook page and excel database for the Dean’s Office.
•	Assist with front office telephone back-up support, typing, filing, customer service support, Xeroxing, scanning, faxing, event and meeting set-up.

positions.title: Information Technology Student Assistant, (CMS)
positions.description:
•	Provided technical support to the Information Technology Enterprise/Applications CMS Department.
•	Assisted the College of Arts and Humanities in updating the department websites utilizing the new Content Management System.
•	Provided Content Management System (CM1) end user training support.
•	Provided weekly website status reports.

positions.title: Database/Programming Intern
positions.description:
•	Assisted the Information Technology Department with Microsoft SQL Server and Access; provided Data extractions, entries and Data Requests.  
•	Created C# applications for daily database extractions.
•	Provided technical solutions to staff.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description: •	Provided tutoring in Object-Oriented (Java) and Assembly Programming.

volunteerExperiences.role: Youth Volunteer in Youth Against Tobacco Use Branch
volunteerExperiences.description:
Participated and Presented at Community Events to the Community and Lawndale City Counsel Members, about the effects of Tobacco use.

Passed, increased Tobacco Fine Law in the City of Lawndale.

Mentoring Program where Corporate Staff enlighten us with Resume, Diversity, Network Knowledge and mentor us. Mentors give us one on one tips of how to view and handle the corporate world and share their most rewarding/career breaking experiences.
